description: Replace the tolerant prompt+parse extraction with Groq strict json_schema structured output (supported by gpt-oss-120b). Add a json_schema param to answer.quick_complete (response_format json_schema, strict:true) and a SCHEMA in draft_intent matching DraftPrefs. Verified: strict output is consistent and shape-guaranteed (no more json_object 400s), and correctly reads sentiment like 'no ubers'->exclude, 'only legendaries'->include. Keyword parser remains the fallback for rate-limit/no-key. Update docs (CLAUDE.md/README) — Groq DOES support structured output; the earlier flakiness was json_object mode, now fixed with json_schema.
title: Use Groq strict json_schema structured output for draft intent
